documents.text: Switch to light mode. Use the operating system's light appearance or an Omarchy light theme. Tool: System. Interface: Appearance.
Switch to dark mode. Use the operating system's dark appearance or an Omarchy dark theme. Tool: System. Interface: Appearance.
Open appearance settings. Find theme, color, wallpaper and appearance controls. Tool: System. Interface: Appearance.
Choose an Omarchy theme. Browse installed Omarchy themes; a light or dark scheme must actually exist. Tool: Omarchy. Interface: Themes.
Adjust volume. Open output volume and mute controls. Tool: System. Interface: Sound.
Choose audio output. Choose speakers, headphones or another sound output device. Tool: System. Interface: Sound.
Choose microphone input. Open microphone selection and input level controls. Tool: System. Interface: Sound.
Adjust brightness. Open display brightness controls when the hardware supports them. Tool: System. Interface: Display.
Open display settings. Find resolution, scaling and multiple display arrangement. Tool: System. Interface: Display.
Adjust night light. Open warm screen colors, Night Shift or Night Light controls where available. Tool: System. Interface: Display.
Turn on Do Not Disturb. Open focus or notification suppression controls. Tool: System. Interface: Notifications.
Choose a Wi-Fi network. Open wireless network selection. Tool: System. Interface: Network.
Open Bluetooth devices. Pair or connect headphones and other Bluetooth devices. Tool: System. Interface: Bluetooth.
Open VPN settings. Inspect configured VPN connections. Tool: System. Interface: Network.
Open system settings. Open the platform's settings or control interfaces. Tool: System. Interface: Settings.
Lock the screen. Lock the current desktop session. Tool: System. Interface: Session.
Open power settings. Open battery, sleep and energy controls. Tool: System. Interface: Power.
Open the file browser. Open Finder, Explorer or the configured Linux file manager. Tool: System. Interface: Files.
Open clipboard controls. Find supported clipboard history or clipboard settings; availability depends on platform. Tool: System. Interface: Clipboard.
Take a screenshot. Capture a visible desktop or window, with the required platform permission. Tool: ctx. Interface: Capture.
Read the selection aloud. Speak the deliberately selected text; only available when this fixture has a selection. Tool: spqx. Interface: Speech.
Transcribe audio. Transcribe the audio that is available in this fixture. Tool: eaRS. Interface: Transcription.
Start dictation. Choose the dictation interface to turn speech into text. Tool: eaRS. Interface: Dictation.
Open Oqto. Open the agent workspace interface. Tool: Oqto. Interface: Workspace.
Add a task. Add a reminder or todo using the user's input text. Tool: lst. Interface: Tasks.
Search past conversations. Look up a prior discussion or agent session. Tool: hstry. Interface: History.
Find a saved memory. Find a remembered preference or operational fact. Tool: mmry. Interface: Memory.
Search project issues. Find a tracked bug, feature or task. Tool: trx. Interface: Issues.
